en.content:
If the system of linear equations

x – 2y + kz = 1
2x + y + z = 2
3x – y – kz = 3

has a solution (x,y,z), z 0, then (x,y) lies on the straight line whose equation is :
en.explanation:
x – 2y + kz = 1 ......(1)

2x + y + z = 2 .........(2)

3x – y – kz = 3 ........(3)

for locus of (x, y) add equation (1) + (3)

4x – 3y = 4

4x – 3y - 4 = 0
